name: Fighting Style
description: You adopt a particular style of fighting. Choose one Fighting Style feat (e.g. Archery, Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection, Two-Weapon Fighting). You can replace your style whenever you gain a Fighter level.

name: Weapon Mastery
description: Your training allows you to use the mastery property of 3 weapons you are proficient with. You can change which weapons you use this with after a Long Rest. See Weapon Mastery cards for property details.
